name: GTMO 441: Games, Detention, Power
short_description: Public sharing of experimental playable media shaped by Mansoor Adayfi’s lived experience, developed with Biome Collective and researchers from Abertay and Mississippi State University.
description:
Join us for a public sharing from a week-long, Creative Scotland-funded residency workshop developing a video game based on the experiences of Mansoor Adayfi, who was detained without charge at Guantánamo Bay for 14 years.

The evening will feature a presentation from Mansoor Adayfi as well as the project team Antonio Aiello, Jenna Altomonte, Joseph DeLappe, Tom deMajo, Malath Abbas and Darshana Jayemanne.

Starting at 5:30pm with experimental games to play, followed by presentations, a panel discussion and live Q&A from 6pm. Refreshments provided; wrapping up between 7–7:30pm.
